evidence.detail: template iterates over all admin_menu items and renders a link for each without any permission filtering
admin_menu() sets permission_required='demimod' on Edit Archetypes and Edit Rules, and 'admin' on everything else, but admin_home() passes the full unfiltered menu to the view
MenuItem has demimod_only and admin_only properties already defined, usable for filtering

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/controllers/admin.py, filter the menu items returned by admin_menu() based on session flags before passing to Admin view: if session.get('admin') is True show all, if only session.get('demimod') is True show only items where permission_required == 'demimod'. Alternatively, add a {{#demimod_only}} conditional wrapper in decksite/templates/admin.mustache using the existing demimod_only property, combined with passing the current user's role into the view context. The controller approach is cleaner and avoids leaking admin URLs to demimod browsers.
triage.notes: The main site nav uses a CSS-class+JS approach to hide admin items, but the admin list page has no such mechanism. The fix is isolated to admin_home() and admin.mustache with no schema changes needed.
